{"notes": "Visit 4, left at 6:30. Picture: chain still continuous and dark from start, over the back and nose, along the belly to the tail end near (28, 15). No pale dominoes, no gaps. Both doubled patches (x~11-14 upper, x~17-19 lower) still connected. Final state looks sound going into the push. I still don't know who placed what, so I'm crediting the chain to no one.

Sofia: Said 'All set here. Hands off, let it fly!' Consistent with her earlier belly-done and double-check claims and the picture. Good closing communication. Still never seen placing anything; ask which stretch she built.

Jack: Told Omar 'nice one', said hands off, all set, great work team. Supportive and he stopped touching things, which is good discipline given his earlier overlaps. But still no concrete check or find from him all session. Collaboration/tone positive; impact and execution remain unproven. Ask what he actually did.

Omar: Not heard this visit, but Jack's praise 'Nice one, Omar' suggests his work was noticed. I can't confirm what it referred to. His earlier verification of the middle patch and scoping stands. Ask what he placed.

Hana: Not seen or heard this visit. Earlier planning, handoffs and tail-tip ownership stand. Still to ask: which stretch she built herself and whether she checked the tail join.

Review caution: evidence is mostly self-reports and praise that match the picture. Before rating, see how the push goes and ask each person directly what they built and checked. Don't let the good final state inflate everyone equally."}
